fields.nameOverride: Welcome to Raxx's Loot Filter! How to set it up:
Start at the bottom and scroll up until you see
<--- this Blue color. These are the instructions for
how to set up the rules BELOW that blue text.
IF YOU EVER SEE CAPS IN A RULE, it's also an instruction.
Have questions? Ask me at Twitch.tv/Raxxanterax <3
This rule guarantees you see every Legendary.
These rules Show Unique & Set Items.
Make sure your BIS Uniques are shown.
As you progress, make these rules more strict.
all Uniques with 3LP or 20 WW
all Uniques with 2LP / 17 WW (UNCHECK UNWANTED)
all Uniques with 1LP / 14 WW (UNCHECK UNWANTED)
Rarest Uniques at LP0 (ADD BUILD SPECIFIC RARE UNIQUES)
Rarest Set Items (ADD ONES YOU WANT)
These rules show every "Resource" in Last Epoch.
I would strongly advise to always leave these rules on.
Glyphs
Keys & Resources
Resonances

Woven Echoes
This rule hides classes you will never play.
It's placed below the rarest uniques and sets in case
you ever want to play them. If you want those hidden too
just drag these rules above the Unique/Set rules.
All items from classes you'll never play (SELECT CLASSES).
These are the Golden Rules for the BIS Items in Last Epoch.
Add the Best Affixes for each slot.
Duplicate the Wpn/OH Rules if you use different bases
to guarantee the right Affix lands on the right base.
Don't add Sub Types unless you're going to wear the item.
Duplicate the Relic rule for each class you're playing.
Uncheck Classes / Wpns / OHs For The Double Exalts.
All Tier 8 Items
Best Weapon (ADD BEST WEAPON BASE & T7 AFFIXES)

Pay very close attention to these rules - they're important.
For the T6 rule pick the best Affixes & Weapon / OH types.
That your class(es) actually use.
Duplicate the T6/T7 Wpn/OH Rules for each different
base type you use if you want different affixes on them.
Warning: DO NOT PICK SUBTYPES. We're slamming these.
The T6s turn off at 85 b/c we only want T7s then.
For the T7 Rule pick bases, but select nearly every affix
because we want to bank up T7s to craft.
The Green Rule allows you to Rune of Havoc a T7
to a BIS Affix. Very powerful, make sure you use this!
Tier 7 Wpns/OHs (CHECK WPN/OH TYPES & DMGS)

Tier 6 Wpns/OHs (CHECK WPN/OH TYPES & DMGS)

These rules let you farm Experimental / Champion Affixes.
They're turned off by default b/c not many builds use them.
Exalted Experimentals are on because they're rare.
Exalted Experimentals (TURN OFF IF YOU DON'T USE)
Experimentals (TURN ON RULE & SELECT AFFIXES)
Champion Affixes (TURN ON RULE & SELECT AFFIXES)
These rules guarantee that you don't miss Exalts / Uniques.
Turn these rules off, or their tone their level down, if you want.
All Uniques - Turns off at 80
All Exalts - Turns off at 60
All Corrupts (SELECT AFFIXES) - Turns Off At 60
Orange Shatter Rules build shards for crafting.
Once have a ton, turn these rules off.
The pink rules allow you to target farm specific Bases / Affixes.
The green rule is for Ascending items.
If you're MG, turn off the COF Requirement on Green.
